physics-killer-04.thinking.0: Collisions and Safety, Horizontal Projection and Gravity (Inquiry)
physics-killer-04.s.s1.prompt: A ball is thrown horizontally from the edge of a $20\,\mathrm{m}$ high cliff and lands on the ground at a horizontal distance of $30\,\mathrm{m}$ from the cliff. physics-killer-04.s.s1.explain: Vertically $20=\frac12\cdot10\cdot t^2\Rightarrow t=2\,\mathrm{s}$. Horizontally $30=v_0t\Rightarrow v_0=15\,\mathrm{m/s}$. Adding the components as $v_0+gt=35$ gives option 1; inverting the tangent gives $\frac34$ (option 2); using only the vertical component $20\,\mathrm{m/s}$ as the speed gives option 4.

20261119-physics-g04-2.s.s1.prompt: [Advanced Thinking] You put an alarm clock inside a vacuum bell jar from which all the air has been removed and set the alarm off. The clock's hammer is swinging and striking the bell, but no sound can be heard at all. What is the reason?
20261119-physics-g04-2.s.s1.explain: Sound is transmitted through the vibration of a material (medium) such as air, so in a vacuum with no air, sound is not transmitted.
